note: Where a visitor on the classic 2 to 3 week Madagascar route goes, for GeoModel scores (trip_prep_geoscore): Antananarivo and its lakes, Andasibe-Mantadia, Ranomafana, Isalo and Ankarafantsika. `packs` is the route mix of the region packs (far north, dry west, spiny south-west): each pack's areas share the weight given, so the first day stays a classic-route day. The country cut uses these own areas only. Coordinates typed by hand, not eBird hotspots; edit by hand.

areas.name: Antananarivo, Lake Alarobia and the Tana rice fields
